items.label: BOTH HOOKED PRICKLES
items.image_role: large woody stem with two strongly recurved lateral prickles and bipinnate leaves
items.caption: The large curved projections belong to the stem itself: prickles, not the same as paired straight stipular spines of Vachellia. Small oval leaflets can be seen on fine pinnae around the twig. Hooked prickles identify the CATCLAW group, not Gregg's species alone.
